== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Blackflame refers to both a powerful lineage and a specialized [[Path]] of magic characterized by [[pure destruction]]. Historically, the [[Blackflame family]] ruled an expansive empire for over five centuries through overwhelming force, once controlling half of the [[Ashwind continent]]. However, the family largely perished decades ago as their own [[madra]] eroded their bodies, spirits, and sanity from within. While the original empire fell after causing massive devastation, a new [[Blackflame Empire]] has since been established. The [[Path of Black Flame]] is an art of [[destruction]] stolen from ancient Black dragons{{!}}black dragons, with its practitioners imitating the power of those creatures. The [[madra]] associated with this path is a volatile, black and red energy that can manifest as liquid-like streams, bars, or intense heat. While it serves as a devastating weapon capable of obliterating physical matter and piercing through spiritual barriers, the power is extremely hazardous to the user. Utilizing Blackflame can cause internal damage, destroying a practitioner's lifespan, mental stability, and ability to advance. Those who wield it may exhibit physical changes, such as eyes that turn black with red irises.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Blackflame is a violent and potent type of fire designed specifically for war. Although it can be called into [[madra channels]] to drill through [[stone]], burn through straps, or destroy dummies during the [[Ruler Trial]], the [[Path]] does not demand a high degree of control. Using this [[madra]] causes [[Lindon]]'s muscles to burn and can race through his channels, yet the [[aura]] risks causing soul blockages during [[cycling]]. Ultimately, the Path of Black Flame{{!}}Blackflame Path erodes the soul, destroying a user's sanity, [[advancement]], and lifespan. This lineage of Blackflames, which included many family members and attendants on various other [[Paths]], fell fifty years ago.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Blackflame is a destructive power and a specific [[Path]] that was once responsible for driving the Tanaban clan to extinction. As a type of [[madra]], it is known for its ability to pierce defenses, break down extra binding{{!}}bindings, and feed on Blood aura{{!}}blood aura. This energy is utilized by [[Lindon]], who can spray it from a punch and has even been referred to by the name itself. The power is also seen within the [[cycling]] of [[Orthos]] and exists as one of the entities contained within [[Naru Gwei]]'s power.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|After completing a mission, the Blackflame is viewed by the [[Skysworn]] as a potentially dangerous liability. This path urges its user to fight for dominance and is difficult to hide, even possessing the ability to taint the flavor of roasted meat. While [[Lindon]] cycles this [[madra]] and trains the [[technique]] under [[Orthos]]'s supervision, he eventually reaches a point of total exhaustion. During his training, the Blackflame helps restore [[Orthos]]'s body and [[spirit]], though a black wedge eventually splits [[Lindon's madra]]. Ultimately, the Blackflame calls [[fire aura]] to the user and can manifest as a blazing presence behind [[Lindon]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|After emerging from a corpse, Blackflame manifests as a [[spirit]] of black-and-Red madra{{!}}red madra composed of black fire. == Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] possesses the fury of Blackflame, which he has used to incinerate a ruined syringe. The power is capable of bursting through an [[Archlady]]'s shield, and [[Orthos]] once questioned if the flame could strike [[Dross]]. During combat, Blackflame gathers around [[Lindon]]'s left hand and has even flared within [[Orthos]]'s [[spirit]]. The [[aura]] can produce dark tornadoes of flame, allowing [[Lindon]] to execute a two-handed blast or manifest bars of the substance from each hand.}}
